name: Bilfinger SE
summary: Bilfinger SE provides industrial services to customers in the process industry primarily in Europe, North America, and the Middle East. It operates through three segments: Engineering & Maintenance Europe; Engineering & Maintenance International; and Technologies. The company offers engineering, project, maintenance, turnaround, rotating equipment, inspection, insulation, scaffolding, corrosion protection, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, control, digital services, and decommissioning of nuclear power plants.
